relationshipToSemarang.explanation: This BAKO QC sample is at a different station and time from CSEM historic 2010–2021 GPS-derived positions. It verifies authentic constellation observations, not measured Semarang movement.

limitations: Derived summary based on authentic file downloaded and decoded in linked GitHub Actions run; original archive not redistributed here.
Pseudorange availability, not a GNSS position solution or measured improvement in positional accuracy.
Not asset-level deformation evidence; no structural inspection or safety conclusion.
